fieldHelp.name: Human-readable name used in menus and search.

fieldHelp.smtpHost: SMTP server hostname used to send email.

fieldHelp.encryption: Encryption mode for the SMTP connection.

fieldHelp.expiryAlert2Days: Final expiry-alert lead time in days before expiry (e.g. 7).

fieldHelp.inApp: Show in-app notifications in the header bell.
fieldHelp.emailChannel: Deliver notifications by email when enabled.
fieldHelp.telegramChannel: Deliver notifications by Telegram when enabled.

fieldHelp.sessionTimeout: Minutes of inactivity before the session expires.

fieldHelp.accountLockMinutes: How long an account stays locked after too many failed logins.
fieldHelp.passwordExpiryDays: Days before users must change their password.
fieldHelp.auditRetentionDays: How long audit and security logs are retained.

fieldHelp.allowedUploadExtensions: Comma-separated file extensions allowed for uploads.

fieldHelp.readOnlyMode: Allow browsing but block create and update actions.
fieldHelp.paginationDefault: Default page size for system list endpoints.

fieldHelp.publicUrl: Public base URL for served objects, if used.
fieldHelp.accessKey: Access key ID for the storage provider.

fieldHelp.accessMode: Whether stored objects are private or publicly readable.
fieldHelp.uploadPathPattern: Path pattern used when storing uploaded files.
fieldHelp.clientId: OAuth client ID for Google Drive.
fieldHelp.clientSecret: OAuth client secret for Google Drive.
fieldHelp.folderId: Google Drive folder ID used for sync.
fieldHelp.syncSchedule: How often Google Drive sync should run.
fieldHelp.active: Whether this item is currently active and available for use.
fieldHelp.prefix: Prefix applied when generating record numbers.
fieldHelp.sequenceLength: Number of digits used in the generated sequence.
fieldHelp.includeYear: Include the current year in generated numbers.
fieldHelp.resetYearly: Reset the sequence counter at the start of each year.
fieldHelp.permissions: Actions this role can perform for each document type.
fieldHelp.permissionRows: Actions this role can perform for each document type.
fieldHelp.icon: Icon shown next to this item in menus and headers.
fieldHelp.color: Accent color used for badges and visual identification.
fieldHelp.enableSharing: Allow sharing links or records when the user has permission.

fieldHelp.inAppEnabled: Show in-app notifications in the header bell.
fieldHelp.emailEnabled: Deliver notifications by email when enabled.
fieldHelp.telegramEnabled: Deliver notifications by Telegram when enabled.
fieldHelp.sessionTimeoutMinutes: Minutes of inactivity before the session expires.
fieldHelp.documentSequenceType: Document type code (for example SALE or PAYMENT). One sequence per type.
fieldHelp.documentSequenceYear: Optional 4-digit year included in generated numbers. Leave empty to omit the year.
